series.name: Residential RAC service codes (Snowflake Aircon mirror of Hitachi RAC meanings)
series.notes: Residential RAC code list with repair guidance (Snowflake Aircon SG mirrors Hitachi RAC service meanings). Numeric codes. Medium (service-company mirror of manufacturer meanings). Model-scoped from light-commercial numeric — never merged.

meaning.en: The room-temperature sensor circuit is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Room temperature sensor ki circuit khuli ya short ho gayi hai

causes.ur: Room sensor ka connector dheela ya nikal hua hai

causes.en: Failed room-temperature thermistor or damaged harness.
causes.ur: Room temperature ka thermistor kharab ya harness kharab

solutions.en: Re-seat the sensor connector and check continuity to the board.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka connector wapas baithayein aur board tak continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor if the reading stays open/shorted.
solutions.ur: Agar reading open/short parhi rahe to thermistor badal dein

notes.en: Independently corroborated by official Hitachi support page wording for code 01 (possible room-temperature sensor or indoor main-board fault).
notes.ur: Official Hitachi support page ki wording ise alag se confirm karti hai code 01 ke liye (room-temperature sensor ya indoor main-board fault ho sakta hai).

meaning.en: The indoor heat-exchanger temperature sensor circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor ki circuit kharab hai

causes.en: Heat-exchanger sensor connector loose or corroded.
causes.ur: Heat exchanger sensor ka connector dheela ya zang lageela
Thermistor open/short ya harness chafa hua

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor at room temperature.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur room temperature par sensor napen

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if out of specification.
solutions.ur: Sensor specification se bahar ho to badal dein

notes.en: Same-number/different-scope caution: ABNML 02 is a safety device, SET FREE 02 is high-pressure. This row is the RAC sensor meaning used by service references.
notes.ur: Same number lekin alag scope ka note: ABNML 02 safety device hai, SET FREE 02 high-pressure hai. Yeh row woh RAC sensor meaning hai jo service references mein istemal hoti hai.

meaning.en: The outdoor unit reported an abnormal condition to the indoor unit.
meaning.ur: Bahar wale unit ne kamre wali unit ko abnormal condition ki report ki

causes.en: Outdoor board, sensor or protection device tripped.
causes.ur: Outdoor board, sensor ya protection device trip ho gaya

causes.en: Inter-unit wiring fault between indoor and outdoor.
causes.ur: Kamre aur bahar wali unit ke darmiyan wiring kharab

solutions.en: Check outdoor unit LEDs/status and the inter-unit cable.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ki LED/status aur inter-unit cable check karein

solutions.en: Clear the outdoor fault and reset from the remote.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki kharabi hatayein aur unit ko dobara chala dein

notes.en: Two agreeing sources: the Hitachi Price List 2009 alarm chapter (Hitachi-Alarm-Codes.pdf, Ultimate Air mirror) also reads 04 = outdoor unit fault, so this row is rated high.
notes.ur: Do sources agree karti hain: Hitachi Price List 2009 ka alarm chapter (Hitachi-Alarm-Codes.pdf, Ultimate Air mirror) mein bhi 04 = outdoor unit fault likha hai, is liye yeh row high rated hai.

title.ur: Drain pan switch / drainage ki kharabi

meaning.en: The drain float switch is activated - water is not leaving the drain pan.
meaning.ur: Drain float switch on ho gaya — paani drain pan se nahi ja raha

causes.en: Blocked or sloped-wrong drain pipe / drain pan overflowing.
causes.ur: Drain pipe band ya galat tedi par lagi hui, ya drain pan overflow ho raha hai

causes.en: Pump failure (ducted/cassette models) or algae/slime in the drain.
causes.ur: Pump kharab (ducted/cassette models) ya drain mein algae/slime

solutions.en: Clear the drain line, clean the pan and flush with disinfectant.
solutions.ur: Drain line saaf kariye, pan saaf kariye aur disinfectant se flush kariye

solutions.en: Verify the float switch resets freely before restarting.
solutions.ur: Dobara shuru karne se pehle check karein ke float switch azaadi se reset hota hai

notes.en: Two agreeing sources: the Hitachi Price List 2009 alarm chapter (Hitachi-Alarm-Codes.pdf, Ultimate Air mirror) also reads 06 = float switch activated, and it matches the SET FREE 01 drain-float family - so this row is rated high.
notes.ur: Do sources is baat par agree hain: Hitachi ki 2009 price document ka alarm chapter (Hitachi-Alarm-Codes.pdf, Ultimate Air mirror) mein bhi 06 = float switch activated likha hai, jo SET FREE 01 drain-float family se milta hai — is liye yeh row high rated hai.

title.ur: Kamre aur bahar wale fan motor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor or outdoor fan motor is not running as commanded.
meaning.ur: Kamre wala ya bahar wala fan motor command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha

causes.en: Fan motor winding open or rotor jammed.
causes.ur: Fan motor ki winding khuli ya motor khud jam ho gaya

causes.en: Fan harness/connector fault or failed driver on the board.
causes.ur: Fan harness/connector kharab ya board par driver kharab

solutions.en: Turn the fan by hand, check supply to the motor and continuity of windings.
solutions.ur: Fan ko haath se ghumayein, motor ki supply aur windings ki continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor or repair the connector/driver as found.
solutions.ur: Fan motor badal dein ya jaisa mila waise connector/driver ki marammat karein

notes.en: Different from ABNML 08 (compressor high temperature) and SET FREE 08 (discharge gas temperature) - see conflict matrix.
notes.ur: Yeh ABNML 08 (compressor high temperature) aur SET FREE 08 (discharge gas temperature) se alag hai — conflict matrix dekhein.

meaning.en: Signal between the indoor control and the rest of the system is lost.
meaning.ur: Indoor control aur baki system ke darmiyan ka signal khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Loose communication connector or broken inter-unit wire.
causes.ur: Communication connector dheela hai ya inter-unit wire tooti hui hai

causes.en: Communication PCB failure or electrical noise on the line.
causes.ur: Communication PCB kharab hai ya line par electrical noise hai

solutions.en: Check the communication wiring and connectors at both ends.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring aur connectors dono saron par check karein

solutions.en: Replace the faulty board if wiring tests good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to kharab board badal dein

notes.en: Official Hitachi support also lists 09 (room-temp sensor or indoor main-board fault possible) - see conflict matrix; treat both as candidates.
notes.ur: Official Hitachi support 09 ko bhi list karta hai (room-temp sensor ya indoor main-board fault mumkin hai) — conflict matrix dekhein; dono ko candidate samajhein.

meaning.en: Communication between indoor and outdoor units is broken.
meaning.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan communication toot gayi

causes.en: Inter-unit cable open/short or loose terminals.
causes.ur: Inter-unit cable khuli ya short, ya terminals dheele

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor communication board failure.
causes.ur: Kamre wali ya beruni unit ki communication board kharab

solutions.en: Verify the inter-unit wiring continuity and re-tighten terminals.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring ki continuity check karke terminals dobara kass lein

solutions.en: Replace the communication board if wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Wiring salamat ho to communication board badal dein

notes.en: PK technician video rxR3Ziq9MJ0 (Lahore workshop) walks through error 10 on a Hitachi inverter unit as a communication/wiring problem.
notes.ur: PK technician video rxR3Ziq9MJ0 (Lahore workshop) Hitachi inverter unit par error 10 ko communication/wiring masle ki tarah waze karta hai.

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor is not running as commanded.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha

causes.en: Indoor fan motor winding open or bearing seized.
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor ki winding khuli ya bearing jam

causes.en: Fan connector loose or tacho feedback wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan connector dheela hai ya tacho feedback wire tooti hui hai

solutions.en: Check motor supply, tacho signal and spin the wheel by hand.
solutions.ur: Motor ki supply aur tacho signal check karein aur wheel ko haath se ghumayein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor if it does not run.
solutions.ur: Agar na chale to indoor fan motor badal dein

notes.en: PK technician video BkcwQaM4z60 (Multan) covers Hitachi error 12 as indoor fan motor issue. Different from ABNML 12 (air-outlet thermistor) and SET FREE 12 (indoor outlet-air thermistor).
notes.ur: PK technician video BkcwQaM4z60 (Multan) Hitachi error 12 ko indoor fan motor ka masla batati hai. Yeh ABNML 12 (air-outlet thermistor) aur SET FREE 12 (indoor outlet-air thermistor) se alag hai.

meaning.en: The evaporator froze; the freeze-protection sensor stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Evaporator jam gaya; freeze protection sensor ne unit rok di

causes.en: Low airflow from a dirty filter, blower or iced coil.
causes.ur: Ganda filter, blower ya jamay huay coil se kam airflow
Refrigerant charge kam hone se coil mein jam (freeze-up) ho gaya

solutions.en: Clean filter/coil, let the ice melt and check airflow.
solutions.ur: Filter/coil saaf karein, barf ko pighalne dein aur airflow check karein.

solutions.en: Leak-test and recharge if the coil freezes again.
solutions.ur: Agar coil dobara jam jaye to leak test kar ke dobara charge karein

notes.en: Meaning agrees with ABNML 13 (freeze protection thermistor).
notes.ur: Meaning ABNML 13 (freeze protection thermistor) se agree karti hai.
